weekly-profit-review.title: Weekly profit review
weekly-profit-review.summary: Goes through every account for the last 7 days: what the ads really earned against what Google and Meta claim, what moved since last week, and the three things to do first.

money-losing-campaigns.title: Money-losing campaigns
money-losing-campaigns.summary: Finds the campaigns that spend more than the profit they bring in, says how much each one lost, and what to do about it.

queue-campaign-fixes.title: Queue campaign fixes
queue-campaign-fixes.summary: Finds the campaigns that lose money, shows a pause or a budget cut for each, and after your yes puts them in Kunads' approval queue. Nothing changes until you approve.

budget-pacing-fix.title: Budget pacing fix
budget-pacing-fix.summary: Says where this month's spend will land against the budget, and after your yes queues the daily-budget moves that land it. Nothing changes until you approve.

client-report-draft.title: Client report draft
client-report-draft.summary: Writes the monthly email for one client in plain words, using only numbers Kunads returned. You read it and send it.

creative-winners.title: Creative winners
creative-winners.summary: Shows which Meta ads and angles actually make money once the product cost is paid, and suggests what to make next.
